title: Studio copilot card: draw the draft posture the tool now sends — 存为草稿 as the primary action, the applied card's lines, and 撤销 through discard-drafts (cloud#2924)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#2974 (the envelope this card maps; back in draft while objectstack-ai/cloud#2924 waits on the maintainer — recorded by the triage seat)

Filing gate ②: a ruling's follow-up whose renderer half lives here. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the cloud#2924 dev's report (on objectstack-ai/cloud#2924; cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2974 carries the tool half). ⛔ Not a claim; no assignee. Grading is triage's.

**Pull (ruled):** objectstack-ai/cloud#2924, the maintainer's 「同意」 on the StudioCopilot artboard (objectui commit `23ef817aa`, `docs/design/ai-build-2026-10-16/artboards/StudioCopilot.*`): a copilot change to an app that is published and holds records is saved as a Studio draft. The change card's primary button reads 存为草稿, with the note 「这个应用已上线，有 N 条记录在用。改动先存为草稿；画布和右侧属性里能看到效果，你在「变更」里核对后再发布」. The applied card offers 查看变更并发布 and 撤销 (which reverts the draft). One row is drawn per change.

**Reader who acts:** the lane that owns `packages/plugin-chatbot` (one dev round). cloud#2924 stays open (`Part of`) until this renders at cloud's objectui pin.

**Dedupe:** REST enumeration of this repository's issues updated since 2026-08-15 (735 issues; control objectui#12294 found), grepped for `changesConfirmLabel`, `detectProposedChanges`, `detectReplayOutcome`, `primaryAction`, `存为草稿`, `discard-drafts`, `appliedCard`, `copilot … draft|撤销`. One hit, objectui#12725, which is about the copilot's right-slot layout, not this card. Not this.

## What the tool sends now (cloud PR #2974, `packages/service-ai-studio`)

- **On the `changes_proposed` envelope (the 确认修改 card):**
  - `posture` (`draft` or `publish`, with the live record count);
  - `primaryAction`: `save_draft` or `confirm`;
  - `summary`, which carries the ruled note in the user's language;
  - one row per change, each with `details` (label, default, required).
- **On the applied (`drafted`) envelope:**
  - `draftState` (the package's pending drafts, read through `listDrafts`, the same source as Studio's 变更 badge, plus `others` when the package holds drafts beyond this change);
  - `existingRows`;
  - `appliedCard`: `{ title, lines }`, for example 「已存为草稿 · 2 项未发布」 / 「已有 12 条记录的续借次数为空」 / 「核对：结构 ✓」.

## What the renderer draws at cloud's objectui pin `ef71a09f9e5f`

- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:1570`: `changesConfirmLabel = 'Confirm'` is a host prop, drawn at `:3168`. No envelope field can make the primary button read 存为草稿.
- `:3068-3089`: the drafted outcome draws a badge and a publish button only. There is no 撤销 and no `appliedCard` lines.
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts:440-458`: `detectProposedChanges` keeps only `summary` and each row's verb, object, field, type, name and details. `:496-528`: `detectReplayOutcome` keeps only `kind`, `packageId` and `publishFailed`. The new fields are dropped before render.
- Today the note renders, but only because it rides in `summary`.

## Wanted

- The change card's primary label follows `primaryAction` (存为草稿 for `save_draft`).
- The applied card draws `appliedCard.title` and its lines, plus 查看变更并发布 and 撤销.
- 撤销 calls the existing server door `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/discard-drafts` (framework runtime `domains/packages.ts`, protocol `discardPackageDrafts`, at framework pin `be076dad28a0`). That door discards **every** pending draft of the package. When `draftState.others` is non-zero, the button must say so before it runs.
- Done when the mappers keep the new fields, pinned by tests beside `mapMessages.ts`, and a render of a drafted outcome shows the title, the lines and both actions.

Dedupe words: copilot card primaryAction save_draft, applied card 撤销 discard-drafts, changes card appliedCard existingRows draftState.
